prayer.heading: A PLACE OF INTIMACY
prayer.text: Father, I thank You for the safety of the secret place. Forgive me for the times I have lived by my feelings or allowed the noise of this world to dictate my peace. I choose right now to step into the Circle of Silence and rest under your unshakeable sovereignty. Anchor my heart in Your absolute truth, clear away the exhaustion, and teach me to walk daily in Your quiet authority. In Jesus' name, Amen.
